# Third-Party Notices
This file lists the third-party software used by BlitzBench benchmark
tasks (declared per task in `TASK.json` under `libraries`) and by the
build infrastructure (`third_party/infrastructure.json`), together with
their license texts.

## Task libraries

### OpenSSL

- Homepage: https://www.openssl.org/
- Source: https://github.com/openssl/openssl
- Version(s) in use: 3.5.5
- License: `Apache-2.0` ([text](third_party/licenses/openssl/LICENSE))
- Notes: Statically linked against a pinned OpenSSL build (see common/cpp/cmake/BuildOpenSSL.cmake); OpenSSL selects hardware-accelerated implementations at runtime.
- Used by:
  - `blitz-task_cpu_crypto_aes` — EVP AES-256-GCM performs the measured encryption; uses AES-NI and PCLMULQDQ where available.
  - `blitz-task_cpu_crypto_chacha` — EVP ChaCha20-Poly1305 performs the measured authenticated encryption; uses AVX2 and AVX-512 vector implementations where available.
  - `blitz-task_cpu_crypto_sha` — EVP SHA-256 performs the measured hashing; uses SHA-NI and AVX where available.
  - `blitz-task_cpu_crypto_sign` — EVP Ed25519 performs the measured sign and verify operations over a small fixed message.

### Video Codec Test: tractor (1080p25)

- Homepage: https://media.xiph.org/video/derf/
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Video_Codec_Test_tractor_1080p25.y4m.webm
- Version(s) in use: 1080p25
- License: `CC0-1.0` ([text](third_party/licenses/tractor-clip/LICENSE))
- Notes: By Taurus Media Technik, from the Xiph.org derf test-media collection, obtained via Wikimedia Commons (CC0 1.0, public domain). The bundled asset is the first 50 frames of the ~28s clip, decoded from the source WebM to raw I420 y4m.
- Used by:
  - `blitz-task_cpu_video_encode` — The bundled 1080p test clip that x264 encodes; the measured encode loop runs over its frames.

### cuBLAS (cuBLASLt)

- Homepage: https://developer.nvidia.com/cublas
- Source: https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda-toolkit
- Version(s) in use: CUDA Toolkit 12.x
- License: `LicenseRef-NVIDIA-CUDA-EULA` ([text](third_party/licenses/cublas/EULA.txt))
- Notes: Resolved with dlopen at runtime, never linked, so the task still loads where the library is absent; the tiled kernel then runs instead. Redistributed in binary form in a private application directory as permitted by Attachment A of the CUDA Toolkit EULA.
- Used by:
  - `blitz-task_gpu_matmul_fp16` — cublasLtMatmul performs the measured matrix multiply on NVIDIA devices, fp16 operands into an fp32 result.
  - `blitz-task_gpu_matmul_fp32` — cublasLtMatmul performs the measured matrix multiply on NVIDIA devices, fp32 operands with the TF32 compute type.

### rocBLAS

- Homepage: https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/rocBLAS/en/latest/
- Source: https://github.com/ROCm/rocBLAS
- Version(s) in use: ROCm 6.x
- License: `MIT` ([text](third_party/licenses/rocblas/LICENSE.md))
- Notes: Resolved with dlopen at runtime, never linked, so the task still loads where the library is absent; the tiled kernel then runs instead. rocBLAS is distributed by AMD under the MIT license (see LICENSE.md).
- Used by:
  - `blitz-task_gpu_matmul_fp16` — rocblas_gemm_ex performs the measured matrix multiply on AMD devices, fp16 operands into an fp32 result.
  - `blitz-task_gpu_matmul_fp32` — rocblas_gemm_ex performs the measured matrix multiply on AMD devices, fp32 operands with the TF32 compute type.

### x264

- Homepage: https://www.videolan.org/developers/x264.html
- Source: https://code.videolan.org/videolan/x264
- Version(s) in use: 0.164
- License: `GPL-2.0-or-later` ([text](third_party/licenses/x264/COPYING))
- Notes: Built as a static library with default settings; no source modifications.
- Used by:
  - `blitz-task_cpu_video_encode` — Encodes the bundled 1080p clip to H.264 at a fixed quality preset; the encode loop is the measured workload.
